summary: Faster W4A8 MoE on MXFP4-CSF checkpoints: compact W4A8 kernels read the compressed expert scales inline
compatibility: No user action required. B12X_W4A8_CSF_INLINE=0 at weight preparation restores the per-call scale expansion.
details: Compact W4A8 MoE kernels (intermediate size 64 mod 128: micro FC1/FC2 and split M16 FC1/FC2) stage 96-byte compressed scale tiles and rebuild each thread's E8M0 scale words in registers, so no routed-expert scale expansion runs before the MoE; outputs are bit-identical.

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 MoE layer (384 experts, top-6) on one RTX PRO 6000, real checkpoint layers: 8 tokens 9% faster than the per-call expansion (3% faster than uncompressed scales), 64 and 128 tokens 9-10% faster (2-4% faster than uncompressed scales).
